blocks.prompt: 14 In how many ways can 5 boys and 4 girls be seated on a bench so that the girls and the boys occupy alternate seats?
blocks.explanation:
5 larke aur 4 larkiyan ek bench par baithne hain, aur shart yeh ke larke aur larkiyan baari baari (alternate) baithein: larka, larki, larka, larki...
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: pehle dekhenge ke kaun sa pattern mumkin hai, phir larkon ko un ki seaton par aur larkiyon ko un ki seaton par tarteeb denge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 alag larke, 4 alag larkiyan, 9 seatein; baari baari baithna hai.
Humein find karna hai: baithne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Pattern fix karo, phir larkon ki tarteeb aur larkiyon ki tarteeb multiply karo.

Pattern dhoondein
\[B\ G\ B\ G\ B\ G\ B\ G\ B\]
Kyun: Larke 5 hain aur larkiyan 4, yani larke ek zyada. Baari baari baithne ke liye dono kinaron par larke hone chahiye. Agar larki se shuru karein (G B G B ...) to 5 larkiyan chahiye hongi, jo hain hi nahi. Is liye sirf ek pattern mumkin hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar larke aur larkiyan barabar hote (maslan 4 aur 4) to do pattern bante (B se shuru ya G se), aur jawab ko 2 se multiply karna parta.

Larkon ki tarteeb
\[5! = 120\]
Kyun: Larkon ki 5 seatein (1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th) hain aur 5 larke unhein kisi bhi tarteeb mein bhar sakte hain.

Larkiyon ki tarteeb
\[4! = 24\]
Kyun: Larkiyon ki 4 seatein (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th) hain aur 4 larkiyan kisi bhi tarteeb mein.

Multiply karein
\[5! \times 4! = 120 \times 24 = 2880\]
Kyun: Larkon ki har tarteeb larkiyon ki har tarteeb ke saath ban sakti hai; fundamental principle of counting se multiply.

Tasdeeq
Seat ba seat box method: \(5 \cdot 4 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 1\)
\[= 120 \times 24 = 2880 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Larkon ki seaton par 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 choices aur larkiyon ki seaton par 4, 3, 2, 1. Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab.
